# The George Washington University, Medical Faculty Associates, Inc. and Universal Health Services, Inc. Finalize Transaction to Transition Clinical Services


Small-Capital-Medical-Group_Logo_RGB


The George Washington University, MFA, and UHS have finalized the transaction to transition clinical services and launch[Capital Medical Group](https://capitalmedicalgroup.com/) under the leadership of CEO Dr. Bruno Petinaux.


As one of the largest academic physician practices in the metro D.C. area, Capital Medical Group brings together exceptional physicians, advanced practice providers and healthcare professionals committed to delivering personalized, innovative, equitable and high-quality care across more than 50 medical and surgical specialties. Capital Medical Group provides clinical services at[The George Washington University Hospital](https://gwhospital.com/) ,[Cedar Hill Regional Medical Center](https://cedarhillregional.com/) and affiliated outpatient locations, ensuring patients can continue receiving care in the familiar settings they know and trust.


Capital Medical Group will continue to advance patient care, expand access to specialized services, educate future healthcare leaders and drive innovation through research and clinical excellence.


We look forward to this next chapter and the opportunities ahead to serve patients and communities throughout the DMV region.


[Learn more about Capital Medical Group →](https://capitalmedicalgroup.com/)
